purpose: Track strategic AI capital signals and translate them into monetization actions.

signals.summary: Stargate announced as a major AI infrastructure project for OpenAI.
signals.capital_size: up to 500B USD planned over four years
signals.why_it_matters: AI labs are treating compute, power and data centers as strategic supply chain, not just IT cost.
signals.small_business_translation: Build AI products that track cost per workflow and can use multiple models/providers.
signals.our_action: Add AI cost control and model routing as future platform capability.

signals.summary: Amazon expanded Anthropic collaboration and total investment to 8B USD; Anthropic uses AWS as primary cloud and training partner.
signals.why_it_matters: Cloud providers want frontier models inside their own infrastructure and marketplaces.
signals.small_business_translation: Package AI workflows so they can later run through cloud marketplaces or managed platforms.
signals.our_action: Keep offer packs, delivery docs and security docs clean for future platform packaging.

signals.summary: Anthropic expanded Google TPU use, reportedly up to one million TPUs and over 1GW compute capacity by 2026.
signals.why_it_matters: Nvidia alternatives matter; cost-performance and energy efficiency are strategic.
signals.small_business_translation: Do not hard-code one model or provider. Optimize by task type, cost and quality.
signals.our_action: Design future model router and cost-per-task dashboard.

signals.summary: Anthropic committed 30B USD to Azure compute; Microsoft and Nvidia planned investments into Anthropic.
signals.capital_size: 30B USD Azure compute commitment; up to 15B USD investment reported
signals.why_it_matters: Frontier model companies diversify across all major clouds; cloud access becomes distribution.
signals.small_business_translation: Our products should be portable and not tied to one vendor.
signals.our_action: Use provider-agnostic architecture for AI calls, storage and workflows.

signals.summary: AI price pressure and cheaper model alternatives make cost per task more important than model brand alone.
signals.why_it_matters: Margins depend on routing simple tasks to cheap models and hard tasks to frontier models.
signals.small_business_translation: Sell outcomes, not tokens; track cost per delivered workflow.
signals.our_action: Create CFO metric: AI cost per task / per client / per product.

signals.summary: Nvidia continues expanding AI infrastructure and AI factory partnerships; memory, power and data center supply chains are critical.
signals.why_it_matters: AI is becoming industrial infrastructure, not only software.
signals.small_business_translation: Physical operations and warehouse workflows will become AI-enabled.
signals.our_action: Prioritize warehouse location intelligence and parts workflow automation.
